_doc: Paths that change what is built and flashed (blinky_time#349 follow-up). A staging head with no change under these since master skips the box's hardware test, and a master commit with none since the last bN cuts no candidate. A path ending in / is a directory prefix. Read by .github/workflows/release.yml and by blinky_time's scripts/testbox/staging.py, at the commit being judged. When in doubt, add the path: a missed one ships untested firmware.
_unfingerprinted_doc: Paths in the list above whose effect the Firmware fingerprint (staging-build.yml: the hex and UF2 built with per-commit fields fixed) does not see: the bootloader, and the tools that make the signed bin and OTA manifest at promotion. A change under one of these never counts as the same image: the hardware test runs and a candidate is cut, judged by the paths alone.
